plugins.name: workflowstacks
plugins.description: The WorkflowStacks catalog inside Claude Code: search 2,000+ open-source AI skills, load any skill's instructions mid-conversation, and keep a personal skill library — via the WorkflowStacks MCP connector.

plugins.name: animejs
plugins.description: Anime.js v4 skill: animate, timelines, stagger, scroll-linked, draggable, SVG and split-text animations, React scope cleanup, and v3-to-v4 migration.

plugins.name: motion-dev
plugins.description: Motion (motion.dev, formerly Framer Motion) skill plus Motion's official hosted MCP server for live docs search: React, JS and Vue animation best practices.

plugins.name: kokonut-ui
plugins.description: Kokonut UI skill plus the shadcn MCP server: install and customize animated React + Tailwind components from the @kokonutui registry.

plugins.name: magic-ui
plugins.description: Magic UI skill plus the official Magic UI MCP server: Backlight glow, marquee, globe, shimmer buttons and 70+ animated shadcn registry components.

plugins.name: v0
plugins.description: Vercel v0 skill plus the official v0 MCP server (OAuth): generate UI and apps from prompts, fetch previews and files, and use the v0 Platform API SDK.

plugins.name: open-higgsfield
plugins.description: Open Higgsfield (OpenHiggsfield AI) skill: run or self-host the open-source Higgsfield AI alternative — one prompt bar for 38 image and video models with your own platform key. No MCP server; upstream repo has no license file (see the skill).

plugins.name: voicestudio
plugins.description: VoiceStudio skill plus its local MCP server (http://localhost:3900/mcp/): the AGPL-3.0, fully local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobooks in 646 languages.

plugins.name: open-seo
plugins.description: OpenSEO skill plus the hosted OpenSEO MCP server (OAuth): keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlinks, site audits and AI visibility from the MIT-licensed Semrush/Ahrefs alternative, hosted or self-hosted with a DataForSEO key.

plugins.name: appflowy
plugins.description: AppFlowy skill: install the AGPL-3.0 open-source Notion alternative on desktop and mobile, self-host the AppFlowy server with Docker Compose (free tier of the commercial server), and know which parts are open source. No MCP server bundled.

plugins.name: cal-com
plugins.description: Cal.com skill plus the hosted Cal.com MCP server (OAuth): bookings, availability, event types and schedules from Claude, the API v2, and self-hosting Cal.diy, the MIT community edition that calcom/cal.com now redirects to.

plugins.name: openwhispr
plugins.description: OpenWhispr skill plus the hosted OpenWhispr MCP server (OAuth): the MIT, privacy-first dictation and meeting-notes app — notes, transcriptions, dictionary and snippet tools, plus its REST API and CLI.
